subject: Renewal kickoff: Staircase commit & QBR options
messages:
From: Emma Clarke <emma.clarke@brightbuild.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@brightbuild.com
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: BrightBuild renewal kickoff — capacity uplift & QBR options

Hi Priyom,

Hope youre well. Were starting to map out BrightBuilds renewal later this quarter and want to kick off planning early. Quick context: our usage spiked during the pilot and were forecasting a 2.5x token increase for peak campaigns next year. Thats driving interest in a staircase commit rather than a flat renewal.

As a first pass wed like:
- a short call to align on staircase tiers and potential discounts
- a QBR to include our product & procurement teams (planning ~60 minutes)
- any capacity planning requirements/red flags we should be aware of now

Proposed QBR windows (PST):
- Tue Aug 25, 9:30–10:30am
- Wed Aug 26, 11:00–12:00pm

Ive attached our usage export and can loop in our procurement contact (cc'd). Can you confirm who from Redwood should attend (ops/finance/product) and whether a preliminary pricing/option set is possible before the QBR?

Thanks,
Emma Clarke
Senior PM, Growth
BrightBuild

Attachment: BrightBuild_Q3_usage_report.csv (CSV)
From: priyom.das@redwood.ai <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Clarke <emma.clarke@brightbuild.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, procurement@brightbuild.com
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightBuild renewal kickoff — capacity uplift & QBR options

Emma — thanks for the note and the export. This is a good early signal and a staircase makes sense given the projected burst. Quick answers:

- Redwood attendees: me (AE), Marissa Cole (Customer Success, renewal play), Stephanie Nguyen (Pricing & commercial ops).
- We can turn around 2 pricing options and a recommended capacity plan ahead of the QBR (before EOD Mon Aug 24).
- Pre-QBR prep: can you confirm anticipated peak sequence length and percent of traffic that will use streaming vs non-streaming endpoints? That'll change queueing/batching assumptions.

Im free for the Wed Aug 26 slot 11am PT. If the team prefers Tue Aug 25 we can do 9:30am PT as well. Ill draft a short mutual agenda and send a calendar invite once you confirm preferred slot.

Next steps from Redwood:
1) Marissa will pull together a run-rate vs burst runbook focused on cost tiers and customer experience guardrails.
2) Stephanie will assemble two pricing constructs: a staircase with quarterly step-ups and a blended commit with burst buffer.
3) Ill draft a mutual action plan with milestones and legal touchpoints.

Sharing the drive link to the draft pricing doc once ready.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

On Wed, Aug 19, 2026 at 11:08 AM priyom.das@redwood.ai wrote:
> Emma — thanks for the note and the export. This is a good early signal and a staircase makes sense given the projected burst.

Thanks — looping in ops and renewals playbook leads. Two quick asks before we finalize options:

1) Timing for data residency/audit review — do you have any renewals that might need exportable audit logs or extended retention? That affects Private configuration and minimum term.
2) If procurement is negotiating net-30 vs net-45 well need to flag that to finance during pricing.

Stephanie — can you confirm if we should recommend a three-step staircase (Q1: +20%, Q2: +40%, Q3: +70%) or a more conservative two-step given their observed monthly variance in the CSV? Emma — if you can confirm preferred payment terms and retention needs well lock the recommended ladder.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Emma Clarke <emma.clarke@brightbuild.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, procurement@brightbuild.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightBuild renewal kickoff — capacity uplift & QBR options

Thanks all — Wed Aug 26 11:00am PT works best for our group. A few clarifications:

- Peak sequence length: typically 512 tokens for batch jobs, streaming calls are ~128 average; peak concurrency expected ~3x baseline during campaign bursts.
- Retention/audit: well need 13 months of audit logs and exportable delivery records for compliance — no on-prem requirement.
- Procurement: net-45 is preferred, but we can be flexible if there are incentives on pricing.

Well plan to include our VP of Product (Ill forward their name), and procurement will join the Wed slot. Looking forward to the agenda and the draft pricing options.

Emma Clarke
Senior PM, Growth | BrightBuild

Attachment: staircase-pricing-options-v2.pdf (PDF)
